title: Senior Enterprise Architect
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Architect to lead the design, governance, and modernization of enterprise-wide technology solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in enterprise architecture, .NET-based application ecosystems, desktop engineering, and on-premises infrastructure environments. This role will be responsible for defining architecture standards, driving digital transformation initiatives, establishing technology roadmaps, and ensuring alignment between business objectives and technology strategies.

  

* **Role: Senior Enterprise Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 10 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Define and govern enterprise architecture frameworks, standards, principles, and technology roadmaps.
* Design scalable enterprise solutions using Microservices, Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), Event-Driven Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles.
* Drive modernization and transformation of legacy applications and enterprise platforms.
* Architect highly available, fault-tolerant, and disaster recovery-enabled solutions across distributed environments.
* Establish enterprise integration strategies across applications, databases, middleware, APIs, and third-party systems.
* Lead architecture decisions for .NET applications, desktop environments, virtualization platforms, networking, and on-prem infrastructure.
* Define infrastructure architecture covering compute, storage, security, networking, and enterprise platforms.
* Establish architecture governance processes, compliance controls, risk management practices, and security standards.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and leadership to align technology investments with business goals.
* Conduct architecture reviews, technology assessments, and technical governance forums.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic improvements and modernization opportunities.
* Mentor architects, developers, and engineering teams on enterprise architecture best practices.
* Support enterprise-wide transformation programs and technology adoption initiatives.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 10-15 years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Application Architecture, or Technology Strategy.
* Strong experience designing enterprise-scale .NET application ecosystems.
* Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman, and Architecture Governance models.
* Strong understanding of Desktop Engineering and Enterprise Endpoint Management environments.
* Extensive experience working with On-Prem Infrastructure, VMware virtualization, servers, storage, and enterprise platforms.
* Deep knowledge of Microservices Architecture, SOA, Event-Driven Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design.
* Proven experience in application modernization, legacy transformation, and enterprise platform consolidation programs.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, high availability, disaster recovery, and fault-tolerant architectures.
* Experience defining enterprise integration patterns, API strategies, middleware solutions, and data architecture standards.
* Expertise in infrastructure architecture, networking, security architecture, compute, and storage platforms.
* Strong knowledge of architecture governance, compliance frameworks, and risk management practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive enterprise-wide technology transformation initiatives.
* Experience collaborating with executive leadership and influencing strategic technology decisions.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Software Engineering, Manager
description:
**Location: Pune, India**  
  
**Position Summary**

Bentley Systems is looking for an engineering manager to lead our AI Acceleration team in Pune, focused on moving practical AI ideas from experimentation into secure, reliable product capabilities that support how infrastructure is designed, built, and operated.

This role combines day-to-day people leadership, technical judgment, and delivery ownership. You will guide a software engineering team, partner with Product Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, UX, Quality Engineering, and AI specialists, and ensure the team delivers well-defined outcomes aligned with Bentley Infrastructure Cloud priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a software engineering team in Pune, fostering ownership, collaboration, inclusion, learning, and reliable delivery.
* Guide the delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities from validated concepts through production readiness.
* Translate agreed product and technical priorities into team plans, milestones, and clear execution commitments.
* Partner with Technical Leads and Architects on solution design, engineering standards, technical trade-offs, and implementation decisions within the team's scope.
* Ensure the team applies responsible AI and engineering practices, including security, privacy, reliability, evaluation, observability, and human-centered design.
* Establish consistent team practices for experimentation, feature evaluation, quality gates, CI/CD, automation, and operational readiness.
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for engineers on the team.
* Use customer feedback, telemetry, and engineering data to improve delivery predictability, product quality, and team effectiveness.
* Coordinate with Product Management, UX, Quality Engineering, Platform, and peer engineering teams to manage dependencies and deliver committed outcomes.
* Communicate team plans, progress, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs clearly to immediate stakeholders and leadership.
* Help the team understand how its work contributes to Bentley Infrastructure Cloud priorities and customer outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* 3+ years of people management experience leading, coaching, and developing software engineering teams.
* 8+ years of software development experience building enterprise applications, cloud services, platforms, or AI-enabled products.
* A strong technical foundation and the ability to participate effectively in architecture and design discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and help the team make sound implementation decisions.
* Experience helping teams move AI-enabled features, intelligent developer tools, data-driven capabilities, or emerging technologies from exploration into production use.
* Working knowledge of cloud-native architecture, distributed systems, APIs, security, data, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience improving code quality, testing, automation, CI/CD, reliability, observability, and operational practices within an engineering team.
* Demonstrated ability to recruit, onboard, engage, and develop software engineers.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, convert defined priorities into actionable team plans, and balance delivery speed with quality and maintainability.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience working with cross-functional and globally distributed partners to deliver team-level outcomes.
* A practical builder's mindset, enthusiasm for applied AI, and interest in creating technology with meaningful real-world impact.

This is a Hybrid role.  

**What We Offer:**

* Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
* An attractive salary and benefits package.
* Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
* Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
* A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
* Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

**Who We Are:**

Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Bentley is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and considers for employment all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, religion/belief, national origin, caste, age, or any other characteristic protected by local law or unrelated to job qualifications.

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Divisional Risk and Control Specialist, VP**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Corporate Title: VP**

**Role Description**

Corporate Banking is a technology-driven business operating in an increasingly real-time, interconnected environment, where clients expect seamless services, integrated platforms and trusted access to data. Corporate Bank (CB) Technology supports this ambition through a complex global ecosystem of business-critical applications, platforms, data services and infrastructure. We are seeking an experienced technology risk professional to play a key role in our Proactive Risk Testing Programme, delivering rigorous, risk-based assessments across this landscape. The role requires the ability to develop a deep understanding of applications and their end-to-end architecture, critically evaluate the design and effectiveness of implemented technology controls, and identify both existing and emerging IT and Information Security risks. Working closely with senior technology, business and control stakeholders, you will translate complex technical observations into clear risk insights, strengthen the testing strategy and drive sustainable improvements that enhance the resilience, security and control environment of mission-critical technology services.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

Reporting locally to the India Corporate Bank Technology Control Testing Lead in Pune and functionally to the CB Technology Testing Lead based in London, you will:

* Lead and deliver risk-based, end-to-end IT and Information Security assessments across the Corporate Bank (CB) Technology landscape, independently assessing the design, implementation and operating effectiveness of key controls.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of business services and their supporting technology, including application and platform architecture, infrastructure, databases, operating systems, cloud services, networks, interfaces, APIs, data flows, batch and real-time processing, and third-party dependencies.
* Perform technical deep dives across applications, platforms, databases and infrastructure to identify and assess existing and emerging IT and IS risks, control weaknesses, root causes, systemic themes and potential impacts on confidentiality, integrity, resilience and regulatory compliance.
* Assess technology lifecycle risks and controls including design, development and production considering aspects such as access management, security, operations and resilience.
* Apply professional judgement to define risk-based testing scope, develop risk and control matrices, determine sampling and testing approaches, analyze technical evidence, and produce clear, well-supported conclusions in line with testing standards.
* Challenge technology and control owners constructively, communicate complex technical risks in business terms and support agreement on pragmatic and sustainable remediation actions.
* Identify cross-application and thematic risks, emerging technology threats, control automation opportunities and opportunities to use data analytics and continuous monitoring to improve assurance coverage.
* Partner with Technology Application Teams, Architects, Engineering, Information Security, Control Owners, the Divisional Control Office, Group Audit and other stakeholders to promote transparency and sustainable risk mitigation.
Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of risk-based testing methodologies, standards, documentation and quality assurance, while providing guidance and technical coaching to colleagues where required.  

**Your skills and experience**

* Extensive experience in IT/Cyber security assessments, technology risk, information security, controls assurance or related discipline, including leading complex reviews in a large, regulated organization.
* In-depth understanding of enterprise technology and application architecture, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, databases, operating systems, networks, APIs, middleware, data integration and third-party services.
* Demonstrable ability to analyze architecture diagrams, data flows, configurations, system logs, access models, vulnerability information and other technical evidence to identify control gaps and assess their business and risk impact.
* Strong knowledge of IT General Controls and Application Controls, cyber security, secure software development, identity and access management, privileged access management, network and cloud security, vulnerability management, data and cryptographic protection, security monitoring, incident management, operational resilience and technology lifecycle management.
* Awareness of emerging technology and risk areas, including cloud security, DevSecOps, automation, artificial intelligence, open-source software, third-party concentration and evolving cyber threats.
* Experience applying recognized frameworks and standards such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL and relevant regulatory expectations; professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or equivalent is desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders and translate complex technical matters into concise, risk-based findings and practical remediation actions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments; knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its control environment would be an advantage.  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career

* Coaching and support from experts in your team

* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs  



**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Principal Test Engineer
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

  

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a **Principal Test Engineer (Test PE) / QA Lead** to partner directly with the Sonicwall Firewall development team. In this high-impact technical role, you will lead feature testing, complex defect reproduction, test plan architecture, and automation development across critical Sonicwall Firewall networking and security components.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* **Dev Partnership & Defect Triage:** Work closely with firmware and software developers to reproduce intricate customer and field issues, isolate root causes, and verify bug fixes.
* **Test Strategy & Planning:** Architect end-to-end test strategies, author detailed test plans, and design comprehensive functional, system, and regression test suites.
* **STLC & Quality Governance:** Drive the complete Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)—identifying, filing, prioritizing, and tracking defects to closure in an Agile environment.
* **Test Automation Engineering:** Develop, execute, and maintain automated test suites (functional, regression, and system) using Python to integrate into continuous testing pipelines.
* **Component & Feature Qualification:** Deep-dive into Sonicwall Firewall subsystems to validate new feature requirements, performance limits, and edge-case handling.
* **Technical QA Mentorship:** Guide and mentor team members on test methodologies, test tool development, and network security validation.

  

**Core Skills & Requirements**

* **Domain & SQA Experience:** 10+ years of software quality assurance experience in the networking and network security domain for enterprise network products, appliances, or firewalls.

* **Domain & Network Security Expertise:**
* + Deep understanding of L2–L7 networking concepts: TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, VLANs, and stateful packet filtering.
  + Strong expertise in Network Security and Next-Generation Firewalling: Deep Packet Inspection (DPI), SSL/TLS, IPSec/SSL VPN, and access rules.
* **Test Automation & Scripting:**
* + Strong hands-on programming/scripting proficiency in **Python** (OOP principles, test framework development, and REST API automation).
  + Experience utilizing traffic generators and test tools (e.g., IXIA, Spirent, Scapy, tcpreplay).
* **Troubleshooting & Issue Reproduction:**
* + Advanced problem-solving skills with proven ability to capture and analyze network packets (Wireshark, tcpdump).
  + Experience analyzing system logs, core dumps, and device diagnostics to triage complex system/firmware behaviors.
* **Methodologies & Processes:**
* + Thorough mastery of SDLC, STLC, defect lifecycles, and Agile/Scrum practices.
  + Experience designing system testbeds simulating enterprise network topologies.
* **Professional Experience:**
* + 8+ years of test engineering and automation experience in the networking/network security domain (with a track record of driving test execution at a senior/lead/PE level).

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical mindset with high ownership of product quality and reliability.
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills to interface effectively with development, product management, and sustaining teams.
* Proven ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams.

description:
### **Description**

ParentPay Group is Europe’s leading software product company and the UK’s largest education technology business. We are on a mission to bring next-generation innovation to positively impact on the lives of millions of parents, teachers, and students every day in over 49 countries.

Our market leading products use cutting edge cloud-based technology to streamline school processes, including secure web and mobile apps that enable secure online payments for school items such as meals, trips, clubs and uniform, improve parental engagement, simplify meal management and - through our product SIMS - collect and manage a database of student information and core school operations.

ParentPay Group’s new offices in Pune are a fantastic tech hub for those looking to boost their careers in software product development.

Our bright team FastTrack their career with international exposure and ways of working based on agile development best practices from globally renowned technology consultancies.

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Driving outcomes: focuses on results and desired outcomes and how best to achieve them.
* Able to execute plans through to action. Persistent to complete tasks and a strong commitment to take action that moves things along to ensure delivery of objectives.
* Ownership & accountability: takes personal accountability and ownership for their work. This includes personal follow through, making and defending difficult decisions and trade-offs, removing blockers, driving collective progress.
* Continuous Improvement: advances by ongoing, incremental improvement through continuous learning, pair-programming, questioning the status quo and trying out creative and novel ideas. Shows curiosity and has a keen interest to drive learning for themselves and others.
* Pragmatic in approach, understanding that software and its architecture are fundamentally about trade-offs. What works today may not work tomorrow, evolutionary architecture is the goal.
* Truly full stack, from UI, Backend, DB, CI/CD to cloud infrastructure and IaC.
* Ability to work in a team of very experienced individuals, understands that egos are not productive, ability to listen and provide objective feedback.
* A lot more focus should be on leading by example and mentoring across all the teams to ensure that the team are successful within their remit.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Hands on experience of .NET Core, React, SQL and Azure.
* Experience with leading industry standard practices for software development and cloud infra such as DDD, TDD and deployment patterns (blue/green).
* Provide hands on technical leadership to the teams, resolve tech queries, ensure that the teams follow architectural principles/guidelines overall tech standards.
* Evaluate and improve the common platform components to help accelerate the programme.
* Actively participate in architectural governance forums such as centre of excellence (CoE) and technical guilds. Furthermore, ensure that decisions made are followed through within the teams.
* Work collaboratively with the Group Director of Technology, Head of Technology and fellow architects to influence and steer technical leads as well as their teams towards pragmatic decisions as well as communicate team progress.
* Undertake R&D, prototype new approaches, technologies, techniques and ensure knowledge sharing to streams.

  

### **About ParentPay Group**

At ParentPay Group, we believe that when schools run well, students thrive. That’s why we’ve spent decades building the operating system that supports well‑run schools – a seamless layer of tools, insights, and support that makes school life simpler for teachers, leaders, caterers, parents, and students alike.

From cashless payments and parent engagement to catering management, library systems, and MIS platforms, we connect the everyday parts of education through simple, secure, and connected tools. What began as a way to make school payments easier has grown into Europe’s leading EdTech group – trusted by over 20,000 schools and 9 million users across the UK and Europe.

Every day, our platforms process millions of payments, messages, and data points, quietly working in the background so schools can shine out front. Together, we’re helping schools save time, cut costs, and create more time for learning.

ParentPay Group is more than a collection of brands. We are a group of people dedicated to supporting well‑run schools and giving time back to teachers, parents, caterers, admin staff – and most importantly, to students.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Location : Pune

###### **About Wai**

Wai Technologies is a cutting-edge firm that pioneers innovative solutions in the tech industry. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, the company seamlessly blends state-of-the-art technologies with visionary strategies to empower businesses worldwide. With a commitment to excellence and a focus on transformative digital experiences, Wai Technologies stands as a beacon of technological advancement, driving growth and fostering innovation in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, we excel in Cloud services, App Modernization, Data/AI, specializing in industries such as Healthcare, Fintech, Construction, and more.

###### **About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Solutions Architect to design and govern the architecture of banking-grade fintech platforms — digital wallets, money market/deposit accounts, payments, and value-added services (VAS). Think systems comparable to Shoprite Money Market, retail banking wallets, or similar high-volume consumer financial platforms.

You will own end-to-end solution design, define integration and data architecture, and ensure every system we build satisfies financial regulation from day one. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and engineering teams who build to your designs.

###### **Key Responsibilities**

Solution Architecture

* Design end-to-end architectures for banking and payments products: wallets, money market/transactional accounts, remittances, bill payments, airtime/VAS.
* Define integration patterns with core banking systems, payment switches, card schemes, and third parties (ISO 8583 / ISO 20022, EFT, RTC, DebiCheck, Rapid Payments, card issuing/acquiring).
* Design ledger, reconciliation, settlement, and clearing flows with strong guarantees around transaction integrity and idempotency.
* Own non-functional architecture: high availability, disaster recovery, capacity planning, and performance at retail scale.
* Lead build-vs-buy assessments and vendor selection (core banking, KYC, fraud, ledger platforms).
* Produce and maintain architecture artefacts: solution designs, sequence and data-flow diagrams, API contracts, and threat models.
* Establish and chair architecture governance (design reviews, standards, reference architectures).

Compliance & Security by Design

Architect systems compliant with South African financial regulation:

* SARB requirements and the National Payment System Act
* FICA — KYC/AML/CFT controls, customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, FIC reporting
* GDPR — data privacy, residency, consent, retention
* PASA / payments industry rules and clearing/settlement participation
* Design for PCI DSS compliance in card data environments.
* Embed security architecture: encryption, key management (HSMs), secure SDLC, fraud controls, and complete audit trails.
* Support audits, penetration tests, and regulator or sponsor-bank due diligence.

Stakeholder Engagement

* Partner with product, compliance, legal, and operations to balance speed-to-market with regulatory obligations.
* Engage sponsor banks, card schemes (Visa/Mastercard), and fintech partners on integration and certification.
* Present architecture decisions and trade-offs to executives and external stakeholders.

###### **Minimum Requirements**

* 8+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years in solution or enterprise architecture roles.
* Proven track record architecting banking or fintech systems in production — digital wallets, money market/deposit products, payment platforms, or mobile money.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title:** AI Platform Engineering Manager

  

**Role Overview:**

EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an **AI Platform Engineering Manager** to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own platform deployment** for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* **Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* **Architect for scale and resilience** — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* **Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers**, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* **Manage model-hosting strategy**, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* **Build observability and monitoring** for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* **Drive security, compliance, and governance** of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* **Optimize infrastructure cost and performance**, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* **Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap**, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

  

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5–8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling
* Understanding of model-hosting economics, GPU resource management, and inference optimization techniques (quantization, batching, caching).
* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

  

**Soft Skills / Leadership**

* Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills — comfortable working with Data SMEs, Product, Responsible AI, and business stakeholders.
* Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership.

title: Senior Specialist Business Consultant (Change Management & Evangelist, AI Incubation)
description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

**Change Management & Evangelist, AI Incubation (SPARK)**
=========================================================

SPARK | CX International Internal Incubation Team | Location: Pune

**So, what's the role all about?**
----------------------------------

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. A tool only creates value if people use it, so we need a change leader who can make AI feel useful, safe, and exciting.

As Change Management & Evangelist, you will lead the people side of everything SPARK delivers - preparing teams for change, building AI confidence and skills, and creating the energy that turns a new tool into a new habit. You bring a consulting background, so you know how to diagnose, structure, influence, and deliver, and how to tell a story that moves senior leaders and front-line teams alike.

You will be a visible champion of AI for CX International. You will demo, teach, listen, and bring what you hear back to the builders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the Business Analyst, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Support Helpdesk, Field Sales Enablement team, HR Business Partners.

**How will you make an impact?**
--------------------------------

You will own adoption for every SPARK solution, from the first conversation with the business through to sustained use at scale and be the voice of SPARK across the organization.

### **Plan and Lead Change**

  

* Assess change impact and readiness for each solution, and map stakeholders, concerns, and the behaviours that need to shift
* Serve as the primary **on-the-ground team leader** for SPARK initiatives, providing hands-on support throughout rollout and adoption phases.
* Build and run change, communications, and rollout plans for each global launch, tailored to regions, roles, and time zones
* Work with the Project Manager so change milestones sit inside the delivery plan, not after it
* Address resistance and concerns openly, including questions about roles and job security, with honest and consistent messages

### **Build AI Fluency and Skills**

* Design and deliver role-based training, workshops, office hours, and self-paced content that teach people to use SPARK solutions in their own workflow
* Create and maintain the SPARK playbook: guides, templates, FAQs, and good-practice examples
* Promote responsible and secure use of AI, in line with company guidance
* Be in constant engagement with key stakeholders and users to identify engagement roadmap

### **Be the Evangelist**

* Tell the SPARK story through demos, showcases, town halls, and internal roadshows that show what is possible and what is already working
* Build and run a network of AI champions across business units who help their peers adopt new tools and share what works
* Collect ideas from across the organisation and encourage colleagues to bring them to SPARK
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leaders on how to lead their teams through AI-enabled change
* Draft and send communications as required for CX International, ELT as project sponsor working with NiCE Comms team and HR.

### **Measure and Improve Adoption**

* Define adoption and value measures: active use, depth of use, sentiment, behavior change, and benefits realized
* Run feedback loops with users, the Support Helpdesk, and the architects, turning recurring issues and requests into improvements
* Report adoption progress and lessons learned to sponsors, CX International Senior Leadership and steering committees

**Have you got what it takes?**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, Organisational Development, Communications, Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 12-18 years of experience in change management, transformation, or enablement, including a background in management or technology consulting
* Proven record of leading change for technology rollouts and shifts in ways of working, across multiple regions or business units
* Strong knowledge of structured change approaches such as Prosci ADKAR, Kotter certification, or equivalent
* Excellent storytelling, facilitation, and presentation skills, including with senior executives
* Experience designing and delivering training and enablement programs for non-technical audiences
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and a practical sense of what they can and cannot do
* Experience in using Notebook LLM, Synthesia, Beautiful.ai or equivalent.
* Ability to influence across teams without direct authority, and to use data to show progress
* Fluency in English

### **You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience in software, SaaS, or technology companies or working for consulting company
* Agentic AI adoption project outside of India is a plus
* Experience running AI or digital champion networks
* Prosci ADKAR or an equivalent change management certification
* Instructional design or learning and development experience
* Experience speaking at internal or external events
* Experience working with teams across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.

Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. The **Customer Technical Architect (CTA)** serves as the premier technical authority and trusted advisor for strategic enterprise accounts. Acting at the intersection of Internet Infrastructure, Cloud Migrations, and next-generation Agentic AI observability, the CTA ensures enterprise clients successfully design, integrate, scale, and monitor complex digital experiences across multi-cloud and AI-driven environments. Customer Architects will work closely across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services and Product teams to provide technical know-how, common tooling and frameworks that solve common customer problems that fall outside the current goals of the product organization and scope of professional service engagements. Customer Architects will also help to translate internal, customer and prospect requests into actionable information with clear business outcomes for the Product and Engineering organizations to be able to prioritize and address.

**Here's a closer look at this key role:**  
**Technical Architecture & Strategic Advisory**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for key enterprise accounts, building trusted technical relationships with C-level executives, principal architects, and engineering leads.
* Understand complex business and operational requirements and translate them into robust, scalable observability architectures.
* Conduct Executive Architecture Reviews, health checks, and strategic planning sessions to align platform usage with business objectives.

**Agentic AI & Modern Observability Frameworks**

* Architect and implement comprehensive observability strategies for Agentic AI, autonomous agent networks, and LLM-backed applications.
* Leverage and advise clients on modern context protocols including Model Context Protocol (MCP), WebMCP, and tool-use interfaces to securely connect AI agents with telemetry, APIs, and data sources.
* Establish performance and reliability metrics for autonomous agents, evaluating execution accuracy, tool selection, reasoning latency, token consumption, and agent-to-agent communication paths.
* Guide enterprise clients in leveraging AI/ML insights to automate incident management, anomaly detection, and self-healing IT capabilities.

**Enterprise Cloud Migration & Digital Experience Modernization**

* Architect pre- and post-migration observability strategies for large-scale enterprise cloud migrations (on-premise to AWS, Azure, GCP, or multi-cloud hybrid topologies).
* Establish telemetry baselines to ensure zero degradation of digital experience, end-user latency, or application performance during complex cloud transitions.
* Provide technical oversight on Internet pathing, DNS reliability, BGP path health, and CDN distribution performance during migration phases.

**Network Pathing, Integration & API Architecture**

* Design end-to-end telemetry architectures across multi-cloud, containerized (Kubernetes), and edge application environments with deep emphasis on core Internet network pathing (BGP, DNS, TCP/IP, ISP routing, CDN).
* Guide clients on building custom API integrations, automation workflows, and monitoring pipelines using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and custom REST/GraphQL endpoints.
* Serve as an advanced technical escalation point to troubleshoot complex routing, latency, and digital experience challenges.

**Enablement, Thought Leadership & Product Alignment**

  

* Deliver best-practice technical workshops, enablement sessions, and product demonstrations to empower customer engineering and operations teams.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, establishing a direct feedback loop with Product, Engineering, and AI R&D teams to influence product roadmaps.
* Author technical whitepapers, architectural integration patterns, and best-practice guides for internal and customer-facing knowledge bases and technical blogs.

**What You'll Need:**

* 6+ years in senior customer-facing technical roles (Customer Technical Architect, Principal Solutions Architect, Principal Customer Success Engineer, or Lead Technical Account Manager).
* Proven track record of supporting large global enterprises, Fortune 500, or Global 2000 accounts through complex cloud and digital transformations.
* Hands-on experience or deep understanding of building, deploying, and monitoring Agentic AI workflows, multi-agent frameworks, and LLM-driven architectures.
* Direct exposure to emerging AI integration standards including Model Context Protocol (MCP), and custom tool-calling/agentic API interfaces.
* Familiarity with tracking AI-specific telemetry: execution loops, context degradation, tool response latency, token consumption, model drift, and safety guardrails.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide Cloud Migration observability initiatives (monitoring application & latency impact during migration to cloud-native/Kubernetes).
* Expert-level understanding of Internet infrastructure and network pathing: BGP (Border Gateway Protocol), ISP routing, DNS architectures, HTTP/3, SSL/TLS, and CDN distribution networks.
* Understanding of multi-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native application deployment models.
* Strong expertise in modern integration patterns, web APIs (REST, GraphQL), webhooks, and data pipelines.
* Hands-on scripting capabilities in Python, Bash, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (Terraform,Ansible) and incident routing ecosystems (ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Jira, Slack).
* Exceptional written, verbal, and technical writing abilities with strong analytical and troubleshooting instincts.
* Ability to articulate complex technical, network pathing, and AI architectures to C-level executives and engineering teams alike.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Willingness to travel periodically for key executive engagements, architectural workshops, or onsite enablement.

description:
Job description

Company and benefits

PRINC020664

Role

Principal Software Engineer- Software Architect

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
**Role Overview:**
  
We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to join the engineering team for the Ready product. This role is focused on leading the technical direction, architecture, and engineering strategy for a modern, scalable, resilient, and intelligent enterprise SaaS product.

  

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a key role in defining the technology stack, shaping the technical roadmap, driving architectural decisions, and leading complex engineering initiatives across multiple teams. You will be expected to bring deep technical expertise, enterprise-scale thinking, and a strong understanding of performance, reliability, observability, and operational excellence.

This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can guide engineering teams through complex design decisions, lead technical discussions, troubleshoot critical technical issues, and influence the long-term evolution of the Ready product. The ideal candidate will have strong proficiency in Java, database technologies, cloud-native engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI-assisted software engineering practices.

We are looking for an engineer who combines strategic technical vision with practical execution, mentors senior engineers, raises engineering standards, and helps build a product platform that is scalable, secure, observable, performant, and ready for the future.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**
  

* Define and drive the architectural vision for the Ready product, ensuring scalability, resiliency, performance, maintainability, and long-term extensibility.
* Lead the evaluation, selection, and evolution of the core technology stack, including application frameworks, cloud-native services, database technologies, observability tools, messaging systems, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities.
* Define and influence the technical roadmap in partnership with engineering leadership, product management, architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex product and platform initiatives.
* Provide technical direction across multiple teams and ensure alignment with enterprise engineering standards, security expectations, and operational goals.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices to continuously improve product capabilities, developer productivity, and system reliability.

**Software Engineering & Platform Development**
  

* Design and build highly scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native services using Java and related enterprise technologies.
* Lead the development of distributed systems, APIs, backend services, event-driven workflows, and data-intensive applications.
* Drive modernization initiatives that improve system performance, scalability, maintainability, and engineering velocity.
* Establish and promote engineering best practices around code quality, testing, automation, design patterns, performance optimization, and maintainable architecture.
* Lead complex cross-functional engineering initiatives that require coordination across multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders.
* Ensure the Ready product is built with an enterprise-level mindset, including strong consideration for scalability, compliance, security, availability, customer experience, and operational readiness.

**Observability, Reliability & Operational Excellence**
  

* Drive platform-wide improvements in observability, monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health management.
* Define and implement observability standards using platforms and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or similar technologies.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex production issues, performance bottlenecks, system failures, and reliability concerns.
* Partner with engineering, operations, and SRE teams to define service-level objectives, operational metrics, error budgets, incident response practices, and reliability improvement plans.
* Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions result in long-term improvements to architecture, automation, resiliency, and monitoring.
* Champion proactive engineering practices that improve product stability, reduce operational risk, and enhance customer trust.

Performance Engineering & Scalability
  

* Drive performance tuning across application services, database layers, APIs, integration points, and distributed system components.
* Identify and resolve scalability challenges in high-volume, enterprise-grade SaaS environments.
* Lead capacity planning, load testing, profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and performance benchmarking efforts.
* Ensure that technical designs account for throughput, latency, concurrency, data growth, resiliency, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with teams to establish measurable performance goals and continuously improve system responsiveness and efficiency.

**AI-First Engineering & Agents**
  

* Bring strong insight into AI trends, AI-assisted engineering, intelligent automation, and agent-based capabilities.
* Drive adoption of AI tools and practices to improve software design, development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and agents within the engineering lifecycle and product ecosystem to improve productivity, quality, and customer value.
* Guide teams on responsible AI usage, including security, privacy, governance, explainability, and reliability considerations.
* Evaluate AI-enabled platforms, developer tools, observability assistants, coding agents, and automation frameworks that can improve engineering outcomes at scale.

**Database & Data Architecture**
  

* Provide technical leadership in database design, data modeling, query optimization, transaction management, and scalable data access patterns.
* Work with relational and non-relational database technologies to support enterprise-grade application requirements.
* Guide teams in designing reliable, performant, and maintainable database solutions that support high-volume data processing and business-critical workflows.
* Lead troubleshooting of complex database performance issues, including indexing, locking, query plans, connection management, data partitioning, and schema evolution.
* Ensure data architecture decisions align with security, compliance, scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability goals.

**Security, Compliance & Enterprise Readiness**
  

* Champion secure software design and development practices across the Ready product.
* Ensure systems are designed with strong consideration for authentication, authorization, data protection, encryption, auditability, and secure integration patterns.
* Promote enterprise readiness through resilient architecture, operational maturity, compliance awareness, and high-quality engineering standards.
* Partner with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure technical solutions align with organizational governance and risk management expectations.

**Technical Mentorship & Influence**
  

* Mentor senior engineers, technical leads, and development teams on architecture, design, engineering practices, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making.
* Lead technical discussions with clarity, influence, and strong engineering judgment.
* Build consensus across teams on complex architecture and design decisions.
* Raise engineering standards through design reviews, technical coaching, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Minimum Qualifications**
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 16+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building enterprise-scale software products.
* Strong proficiency in Java, including modern Java frameworks, backend service development, concurrency, performance tuning, and scalable application design.
* Deep experience with database technologies, including relational databases, SQL optimization, schema design, transaction management, indexing strategies, and performance troubleshooting.
* Proven experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of observability platforms, monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and production diagnostics.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with performance engineering, including profiling, load testing, capacity planning, caching, query optimization, and system tuning.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS architecture, operational readiness, resiliency, availability, security, and scalability.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions, define technical roadmaps, and influence engineering direction across multiple teams.
* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, database, and integration layers.
* Strong understanding of AI-assisted software engineering practices, AI tools, and emerging agent-based development or automation models.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, mentoring, and technical leadership skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Experience working on large-scale enterprise SaaS products serving global customers.
* Experience defining or evolving a product-level technology stack and long-term technical roadmap.
* Expertise with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging platforms, distributed caching, and asynchronous processing patterns.
* Hands-on experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, or similar platforms.
* Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, or large-scale architecture evolution initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of secure software development, compliance-aware design, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with AI coding assistants, engineering agents, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled operational tooling.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior technical talent and establish engineering standards across teams.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical problem solving and delivery execution.

Key Attributes
  

* Strategic technical thinker with strong execution discipline.
* Hands-on engineering leader who can guide architecture while also diving deep into technical issues.
* Strong enterprise mindset with focus on reliability, performance, observability, scalability, and security.
* Clear communicator who can lead technical discussions and influence decisions across teams.
* Passionate about engineering excellence, innovation, AI-first development, and continuous improvement.
* Comfortable working in complex environments with multiple stakeholders, systems, and priorities

  
**Company Overview:**

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.

title: Technical Architect — Higher Ed Platforms
description:
Strata Information Group (SIG) is a trusted leader in higher‑education technology consulting, supporting colleges and universities with ERP/SIS modernization, digital transformation, CRM, cybersecurity, and strategic advisory services. As a long‑standing and deeply embedded partner within the higher‑education sector, SIG brings together technical depth, operational insight, and a culture rooted in integrity, collaboration, and exceptional client service. Our heritage is built on hands‑on expertise, genuine relationships, and a commitment to delivering value with humility and excellence—values that continue to define us as we scale.

### **Senior Technical Architect – Higher Education Platforms**

**Location:** Pune, India | Hybrid  
**Employment:** Full-time, engaged through SIG's Employer of Record in India  
**Base salary:** ₹25–37 lakh per annum (LPA)  
**Experience:** 10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in consulting or professional services delivery for external clients  
**Reports to:** Lead – India Centre of Excellence  
**Working hours:** Flexible, with 3–4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern morning. Typically, your day will finish around 9:00–10:00 pm IST, with a correspondingly later start.

Build the solution. Set the technical standard.

Strata Information Group (SIG) is a US-based leader in higher education technology consulting. We help colleges and universities modernise their student information, HR and finance systems through ERP/SIS implementation, integration, digital transformation, CRM and cybersecurity work.

We are building our first engineering Centre of Excellence in Pune. This is a founding-team role: you will help establish how the team designs and builds. You will own technical architecture across application integrations, Ellucian Experience Cards, workflow automation and data migration—and write a meaningful part of the production code yourself. This role carries delivery accountability, not just design accountability.

**Ellucian experience is not required.** Deep integration expertise, direct US client delivery experience and the ability to learn a new platform quickly are essential.

What you will do

* **Own architecture and delivery:** Design secure integrations, web applications, identity solutions and workflow automation on Ellucian platforms. Document practical designs that work within platform, infrastructure and timeline constraints, and stay hands-on with production code.

* **Build platform expertise:** Learn Ellucian Ethos, Experience, Workflow, Banner/Colleague data structures and the API catalogue, then turn that knowledge into reusable patterns and documentation.

* **Lead and mentor:** Run architecture and code reviews, resolve complex technical problems and help new engineers become productive through hands-on guidance.

* **Work directly with US clients:** Lead technical discovery, explain designs and trade-offs, and support project scoping, estimation and technical proposals.

* **Lead data migration:** Own source analysis, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation and cutover into Ellucian platforms.

* **Deliver and improve:** Meet your assigned annual billable utilisation target alongside mentoring and design reviews. Use AI coding assistants responsibly and contribute to SIG's internal AI development tools.

What you will bring

* **Engineering and consulting experience:** 10+ years of professional software engineering, including at least 5 years delivering for external clients in consulting or professional services. Direct experience leading technical discussions, presenting designs and managing expectations with US-based clients is required.

* **Deep integration and API expertise:** Experience designing, securing, versioning and operating integrations at scale—not simply consuming REST endpoints. Strong command of synchronous REST, event-driven, message-based, batch, file-based and ETL integrations; point-to-point and hub models; JSON, pagination, rate limits, idempotency, retries, versioning and webhooks.

* **Identity and security:** Hands-on SAML 2.0 and single sign-on (SSO), including troubleshooting failed assertions; working knowledge of OIDC, identity providers, federation, attribute and role mapping, and provisioning. Strong OAuth 2.0, JWT, API key, token and scope design, least-privilege service-account access, secrets handling and secure data exchange skills.

* **Hands-on web engineering:** Expert-level TypeScript and React.js, including component architecture, state management and performance; deep server-side Node.js, including API design, asynchronous patterns, error handling, dependency management and production debugging. Ability to design end-to-end web applications across the client, APIs, services, data, caching, sessions and deployment.

* **Workflow and data delivery:** Business process automation expertise and hands-on experience with a workflow or business process management (BPM) tool. Experience planning and executing enterprise data migrations, plus SQL, relational data modelling, Git and modern continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) practices.

* **Technical leadership and learning:** Demonstrated architecture leadership and mentoring, sound judgement within delivery constraints, clear written and spoken English, and a specific example of learning an unfamiliar platform quickly. Fluency with AI-assisted development, including verifying and explaining AI-generated output before release.

Preferred experience—not essential

* Ellucian Banner, Colleague, Ethos, Experience or Workflow; higher education technology; or enterprise resource planning (ERP), student information systems (SIS), human resource management systems (HRMS) or finance platforms.

* Postman, OpenAPI/Swagger, GraphQL or API gateways; AWS S3, SFTP and secure file exchange.

* AI/ML tools, large language model (LLM) APIs, prompt engineering, internal developer tools or AI-assisted automated testing.

* Low-code/no-code platforms, distributed teams across time zones, or pre-sales solution design and estimation.

Your first months at SIG

The role requires strong expertise in the Workato platform, including recipe development, API integrations, workflow orchestration, data transformation, error handling, and automation governance. The candidate will work closely with architects, business analysts, project managers, backend developers, and other technical stakeholders to translate business and integration requirements into robust automation solutions. **Key Responsibilities**

* Experience with:
* Recipe development, triggers, actions, and conditional logic.

* Error handling, retries, exception management, and operational monitoring.
* Workato connectors, including standard and custom connectors.
* API platforms, webhooks, and event-based integrations.
* Understanding of Workato environments, connection management, deployment practices, and access controls.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues and optimize recipe performance.

* API & Enterprise Integration

* Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth 2.0, API keys, and token-based authentication.
* Experience with pagination, rate limits, asynchronous processing, retries, and API error handling.
* Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, system interoperability, and data synchronization.
* Exposure to microservices and event-driven architecture is preferred.

* Course and learning content synchronization.
* Enrollment, completion, and progress tracking.

* Integration with HRMS, CRM, identity management, and other enterprise systems.
* Ability to understand LMS data structures and design reliable, automated data exchange workflows.

* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases for data validation and troubleshooting.

* Ability to use AI tools to support workflow design, API analysis, documentation, troubleshooting, and test-case creation.

* Ability to evaluate AI-generated solutions for correctness, security, reliability, and maintainability.

**Technical Leadership & Governance-** The candidate should demonstrate the ability to:

  

* Own integration solution design and make sound technical decisions.

* Define reusable patterns and best practices for Workato development.

Requirement

Solutioning experience
  
  
Minimum 6+ years of demonstrable solutioning experience across multiple industry domains. BFSI / Banking Financial Services exposure is mandatory.

Minimum 5+ years of hands-on pre-sales experience covering the complete pursuit lifecycle, not only proposal coordination or delivery support.
  
  
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
  

* Own solution architecture for RFI, RFP, RFQ, proactive proposals, renewals, expansions, and complex deal pursuits from discovery through solution defense and handover.

* Coordinate contributions from multiple technology practices and domain SMEs, ensuring a single coherent architecture and consistent proposal narrative.

* Support transition from pre-sales to delivery through structured solution handover, architecture baseline, assumptions log, dependencies, risks, estimates, and committed scope.

* Solution architecture and technical response ownership
* Architecture diagrams, solution flows, NFRs and technology selection

SOLUTION ARCHITECTURE TECHNICAL EXPECTATIONS

BFSI is mandatory, and experience should show the ability to adapt architecture and solution approaches to different client contexts rather than relying on a single product, technology stack, or domain.

title: Agentic AI Solution Architect
description:
Role Purpose

TGC is transitioning its software engineering environment toward an Agentic-AI-first development model, where AI agents participate across requirements, architecture, frontend and backend development, testing, security, deployment and ongoing application maintenance.

We are looking for a hands-on Agentic AI Solution Architect who can architect, implement and govern this engineering environment.

This is not a conventional Solution Architect or Generative AI role. The successful candidate must be capable of using AI coding agents to build and deploy real production applications while establishing the architecture, guardrails and development practices required for engineering teams to work effectively with agents.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Engineering Architecture

- Design TGC's end-to-end Agentic Software Development Lifecycle (A-SDLC).

- Build and configure specialized agents for frontend, backend, database, QA, security and DevOps activities.

- Design effective system prompts, context engineering, tool access, agent memory and orchestration.

- Establish agent-to-agent workflows and human approval gates.

- Create reusable engineering instructions and standards across TGC products.

Application Architecture

Own and guide architecture across:

- Angular and TypeScript

- Angular Micro-Frontend architecture

- .NET / ASP.NET Core

- REST APIs

- Microservices

- SQL and NoSQL databases

- Azure cloud services

- API integrations

- Authentication, authorization and RBAC

- Scalable multi-tenant SaaS architecture

Agentic Development

The role must be highly hands-on.

The candidate should be able to take:

Requirement → Architecture → Agent Instructions → Generated Code → Testing → Security Validation → Deployment without defaulting to manual coding whenever an agent encounters a problem.

When agents fail, the individual should diagnose whether the failure resulted from context, instructions, architecture, tooling, permissions, test coverage or model limitations and improve the agentic system accordingly.

DevOps & Deployment

- Design AI-assisted CI/CD workflows.

- Implement automated build, testing and deployment.

- Work with Azure DevOps/GitHub pipelines.

- Implement Infrastructure as Code where appropriate.

- Manage Azure Key Vault and application secrets securely.

- Establish automated rollback, logging and monitoring.

Engineering Governance

Create and enforce:

- Agent-first development standards

- Coding and architecture standards

- Automated testing requirements

- AI-generated code review processes

- Security validation

- Human approval gates

- Production deployment controls

- Documentation and traceability of agent-generated changes

Team Enablement

A major responsibility will be helping TGC's existing engineering team transition from conventional development to AI-native engineering.

Essential Technical Skills

Strong hands-on experience with:

- Agentic AI / AI coding agents

- LLM system prompting and context engineering

- Tool/function calling and agent orchestration

- MCP or equivalent agent-tool integration

- Git/GitHub

- Angular / TypeScript

- .NET / ASP.NET Core

- REST APIs and microservices

- SQL / database architecture

- Microsoft Azure

- Docker / containers

- CI/CD

- Automated testing

- Application security

Experience with modern AI development environments such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or equivalent agentic coding platforms is highly desirable.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are specifically looking for someone who thinks:

"How do I make the agent solve this reliably and repeatedly?"

rather than:

"I'll just fix the code myself."

The ideal candidate is:

- Architecturally strong

- Extremely hands-on

- Comfortable experimenting with rapidly evolving AI technology

- Strong at debugging AI-agent behaviour

- Able to distinguish AI limitations from poor instructions or architecture

- Security conscious

- Product and UX aware

- Comfortable challenging traditional software-development practices

- Capable of teaching other engineers how to work effectively with AI agents

Selection Process

Candidates should expect a practical assessment.

They may be provided with a partially functioning application and access to an AI coding environment and asked to:

Diagnose, correct, test and deploy the application primarily through AI agents rather than manually rewriting the code.

We are interested not simply in whether the candidate solves the problem, but how they design, instruct, supervise and improve the agentic engineering process used to solve it.

Success in the First 90 Days

The successful candidate should:

- Establish TGC's Agentic Development Architecture.

- Implement the Agentic SDLC.

- Create reusable FE, BE, QA, Security and DevOps agents.

- Establish automated development and deployment pipelines.

- Introduce measurable agentic engineering standards.

- Reduce dependence on manual coding.

- Improve development velocity without compromising security or quality.
